QuestInfo.name: Pia's Present For a Friend
QuestInfo.0: You went to get Pia's cape back, but Rina won't give it up until she gets back all the stuff Pia borrowed.
QuestInfo.1:
You delivered #b1 Black Crystal, 1 Ancient Document, and 30 horns of Tauromacis#k to Rina, and in return, you received Pia's #bRed Cape#k. You should take the cape, along with #b15 Silvers, 50 Dragon Skins, and 40 screws#k to Pia.

0.0: I have to admit, that cape was an eyesore, but it was very well made. I'm kind of going to miss it...

1.0: Okay. Now I can just give these to #p1052002# and get the claw. Oh yeah, let me give you a reward. My family makes armor. Let me give you something that should come in handy.

item.0: You still haven't brought the materials? Bring me 1 #b#t4031043#, 5 #t4011004#s, 5 #t4000030#s, and 10 #t4003000#s#k! Thanks! Oh, this should help you out... I lent the #t4031043# to #p1010100# of #m100000000#! You should be able to get it from #p1010100#.
